description: This file is a Python script that implements command-line tools for translating, managing, and updating documentation files, utilizing various external libraries such as git, typer, yaml, and a custom Agent class for language model interactions.

methods.name: dict[str,str] get_langs()
methods.description: Loads language name mappings from a YAML config file.

methods.name: Path generate_lang_path(*, lang: str, path: Path)
methods.description: Constructs the path for a localized documentation file based on language.

methods.name: Path generate_en_path(*, lang: str, path: Path)
methods.description: Constructs the path for the English source documentation file.

methods.name: None translate_page( *, language: Annotated[str, typer.Option(envvar="LANGUAGE")], en_path: Annotated[Path, typer.Option(envvar="EN_PATH")], )
methods.description: Translates a documentation page from English to a specified language using an LLM-powered agent.

methods.name: Iterable[Path] iter_all_en_paths()
methods.description: Iterates over all English documentation Markdown files in priority order.

methods.name: Iterable[Path] iter_en_paths_to_translate()
methods.description: Filters and yields paths for documentation files that need translation into a specified language.

methods.name: list[str] list_llm_translatable()
methods.description: Lists all available languages that can be translated via LLM based on the presence of prompt files.

methods.name: None llm_translatable_json( language: Annotated[str | None, typer.Option(envvar="LANGUAGE")] = None, )
methods.description: Outputs the list of translatable languages as JSON, optionally filtering for a specific language.

methods.name: None commands_json( command: Annotated[str | None, typer.Option(envvar="COMMAND")] = None, )
methods.description: Outputs available command names as JSON, optionally filtering for a specific command.

methods.name: list[Path] list_removable(language: str)
methods.description: Lists documentation files in a language that can be removed because they are missing from the English source.

methods.name: list[Path] list_all_removable()
methods.description: Aggregates and lists all files across languages that can be removed.

methods.name: None remove_removable(language: Annotated[str, typer.Option(envvar="LANGUAGE")])
methods.description: Deletes documentation files that are identified as removable for a given language.

methods.name: None remove_all_removable()
methods.description: Removes all identified removable documentation files across all supported languages.

methods.name: list[Path] list_missing(language: str)
methods.description: Lists files that are missing translations in the specified language.

methods.name: list[Path] list_outdated(language: str)
methods.description: Lists files where the translation is outdated compared to the latest English source.

methods.name: None update_outdated(language: Annotated[str, typer.Option(envvar="LANGUAGE")])
methods.description: Re-translates and updates outdated translation files.

methods.name: None add_missing(language: Annotated[str, typer.Option(envvar="LANGUAGE")])
methods.description: Translates and adds missing documentation files for the specified language.

methods.name: None update_and_add(language: Annotated[str, typer.Option(envvar="LANGUAGE")])
methods.description: Performs both update of outdated translations and addition of missing ones.

methods.name: None make_pr( *, language: Annotated[str | None, typer.Option(envvar="LANGUAGE")] = None, command: Annotated[str | None, typer.Option(envvar="COMMAND")] = None, github_token: Annotated[str, typer.Option(envvar="GITHUB_TOKEN")], github_repository: Annotated[str, typer.Option(envvar="GITHUB_REPOSITORY")], )
methods.description: Creates a pull request with all pending translation updates, automating branch creation, commit, push, and PR creation on GitHub.
